The conditional design-team router returned no_split with zero specialist subtasks. That result neither supplies a specialist repair decision nor replaces deterministic checker and real-tool evidence.

If the repaired interface permits an actual VCS run and that run has a value, order, protocol, liveness, or frontier failure, run current-layer boundary tracing and targeted replay before any code repair. Do not reopen lower layers unless the trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer certificate.

After interface and VCS prerequisites pass, execute the remaining board-layer functional, deadlock, AXI, DDR, semantic, numeric, order, weight-consumption, and output-frontier gates using the exact wrapper and independent target-model reference.
Record the retry outcome and trust barrier in SACG. Promote nothing unless every required board-layer gate and semantic evidence contract passes.
risks: A stale or partially bound identity/compile manifest could execute a different source set or simulator than the exact board design, invalidating every resulting functional claim.

The missing VCS provenance capability may conceal an error in a generated board source, manifest, language mode, or compile ordering; editing the wrong file could contaminate certified kernel or exact-wrapper evidence.

A successful interface check alone does not establish board functional correctness, numeric agreement, token/data order, AXI protocol correctness, DDR image roundtrip, liveness, weight consumption, or output-frontier progress.
The functional_sim failure is currently dependency-blocked and must not be interpreted as an RTL failure or used to select a downstream output-only patch.
Repeated repair attempts with changed source fingerprints can leave stale contamination barriers active; only newly hash-bound reports can supersede rejected artifacts.
Reopening leaf operators or the connected kernel without a direct current contradiction would violate the hierarchical anti-spin contract and could destroy valid lower-layer evidence.
Changing atol, rtol, max_mismatch_fraction, checkpoint, stimulus, expected outputs, semantic testbench hashes, or DUT scope would invalidate the repair comparison and is prohibited.
Embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail behavior must not be added to the DUT golden or Transformer-block weight-consumption boundary.
